name: sim_ac5_mock_merch_order_lookup_and_damaged_item
transcript:
User: event: welcome
Agent: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here in the garage, so how can I help you support the Silver Arrows today?
User: Can you check the status of my merch order #1001, and what should I do if the cap arrived damaged?
Agent Action: Call Tool lookup_mock_merch_order with args {'order_id': '1001'}
Agent: In our simulated mock demo system, order 1001 for the George Russell team cap is marked as delivered by DHL Express with tracking number DHL-MB-984210. Since your cap arrived damaged, you are eligible for an immediate no-cost replacement or a free exchange within 30 days at the official store, shop.mercedesamgf1.com.
User: That is great to hear, thank you for the instructions. I will follow up with the shop to process the replacement.
Agent: You are very welcome, and I am glad I could help you with that. It is a shame about the cap, but the team at the official store at shop.mercedesamgf1.com will get you sorted with a fresh one for the next race. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

step_details.goal: Check the status of Mercedes merch order #1001 and ask what to do if the cap arrived damaged
step_details.success_criteria: The agent looks up order #1001 using the lookup tool, reports the Delivered status, explains the return/exchange/damaged-item options, and clearly discloses that the merch support flow is mocked/simulated. Receiving the mocked order status and damaged-item guidance counts as a successful outcome.
step_details.justification: The agent provided the status and the instructions for the damaged item. The user has acknowledged these instructions.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent called the lookup_mock_merch_order tool to look up merchandise order #1001 and reported the Delivered status (not an ungrounded 'Shipped' or 'DHL-9928174' status)
expectation_details.justification: The agent successfully called the tool with the correct order ID and correctly reported that the order was 'delivered' via DHL Express with the tracking number DHL-MB-984210.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent explained return, exchange, or damaged-item options
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly informed the user that they are eligible for an immediate no-cost replacement or a free exchange within 30 days.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent clearly disclosed that the merchandise order data and support flow are mocked or simulated for demonstration
expectation_details.justification: The agent explicitly prefaced their response by stating, 'In our simulated mock demo system,' and the tool response also contained a disclaimer regarding the mock nature of the data.
